provenance_policy: Artifacts are copied from an already-downloaded, content-verified local cache (C:/dev/engine-lab) and re-verified in this tree by tools/verify_sources.py against the SHA-256 recorded below. Nothing is re-downloaded at build time and nothing runs on the network at runtime.
rules: Every SHA-256 below was computed with hashlib.sha256 over the file copied into this tree, not copied from any manifest.
Source verification checks content, never HTTP status: a 200 can still return an error page.
All models are consumed at STATIC shapes. The NPU rejects dynamic shapes.
Do not substitute a model, a source, or a version without re-running tools/verify_sources.py and recording the new result.
measured_* fields come from cv2.VideoCapture on the copied file. They are measurements, not estimates, and they are not rounded to a target.
